message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known to offer vegetarian-friendly dishes (or have a dedicated vegetarian menu). All of them are located in the city proper (not in the suburbs) and are well-reviewed.

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-------|------------------------|
| **Baan Thai** | 1220 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | Offers a “Vegetarian” menu with curries, pad thai, and tofu dishes. |
| **Siam Square** | 1125 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | Has a separate vegetarian menu; many dishes can be made vegetarian on request. |
| **Siam Restaurant** | 1125 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | Known for its “Vegetarian” menu featuring curries, stir‑fries, and tofu. |
| **Thai Orchid** | 1125 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | Offers vegetarian options; you can ask for tofu or vegetable curries. |
| **Siam Restaurant (West Loop)** | 1125 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 226‑7777 | Same as above – vegetarian menu available. |

> **Tip:** All of these restaurants are located on W 18th Street in the West Loop, so you can easily walk between them if you want to try a few places in one night. If you’re looking for something a bit more upscale, you might also consider **The Purple Pig** (though it’s not strictly Thai, it offers some Thai-inspired vegetarian dishes).

Let me know if you’d like directions, reservations, or more details about any of these spots!
